NOT LIVE — this file is read by nothing today. Do not trust it until Task 20.1 has been through it.
Adoption of an MCP client extension was deferred by the maintainer on 2026-07-28 (it is a trust
decision, REQ-SEC-006, and the tool_call gating it must be verified against is Task 13.3). Both
candidates' sources were read on that date, and three things are already known to be wrong here:
1. LOCATION. Neither candidate reads a repo-root mcp.json. pi-mcp-extension reads <cwd>/.pi/mcp.json;
pi-mcp-adapter reads <cwd>/.mcp.json or <cwd>/.pi/mcp.json. `.pi/mcp.json` is the one path both
accept. Moving it needs a design §17 amendment, so it waits for the adoption decision.
